tools.name: GitHub
tools.purpose: Source code, pull requests and workflow coordination. The TOKYO-BEANS organization is on GitHub Team. The organisation ruleset `TOKYO-BEANS baseline` requires a pull request and blocks force-pushes and deletion on every repository, future ones included; each repository's `Stack Atlas checks` ruleset, written by the Stack Atlas standard, requires its Depot CI checks, the Semgrep check and the CodeQL code-scanning rule (errors, and security alerts high or higher, block the merge). The organisation security configuration `TOKYO-BEANS standard` (all repositories, default for new ones) turns on Secret Protection (push protection and validity checks) and Code Security (CodeQL default setup: on Depot runners through GitHub Actions in the private repositories since 17 November 2026, on GitHub-hosted runners in the public one), and keeps Dependabot alerts and security updates off. Dependabot does version updates only, from the standard's `.github/dependabot.yml`. GitHub's AI scanning (AI Scan and Scan for AI applications, billed by use) was turned off on 17 November 2026; how, and the proof still owed, are in the security-costs recipe. The Advanced Security trial ends about 28 November 2026; what the owner buys then is decided after Semgrep's code rules are measured against the CodeQL alerts.

tools.name: Semgrep

CodeQL scans the code; Semgrep's code rules are not part of the gate. Free limits: 10 private repositories, 10 contributors.
